tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// 'jam dpal gshin rje king kang nag po'i srung zlog gsad gnan gyi las gzhung phrin las kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal// dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo// mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing gyur la// gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi// dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i// dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol// dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs// nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi// phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos// ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*// dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams// dus gsum bzhugs la lus 'bul lo// tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i dge ba rnams// bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ /e/ stong pa'i ngang las gnam sa gnam lcags kyi// 'khor lo spu gri ltar rno g.yas g.yon 'khor// de nang rdo rje'i rwa gur me 'bar nang*// gnam lcags las grub rdo rje rtse dgu pa// yar rtse tshangs gnas mar sne na rag gnas// byad ma gan rkyal gnas pa'i lce snying gzir// rdo rje'i lte bar rin chen gzhal yas khang*// gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs rgyan rdzogs dbus// 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi rtsibs bcu nyis rim dbus// chos 'byung chu glang pad nyi dgra bgegs steng*// rang sems hūm̐ yig mthing nag 'phro 'du las// gdod ma'i dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed// mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa// g.yas gsum ral gri tho ba gtun shing dang*// g.yon gsum lcags kyu sbrul zhags thong gshol bsnams// dur khrod dpal chas yongs rdzogs gar dgu'i nyams// spyi mgrin snying ga lte ba gsang gnas su// 'jam dpal rta mgrin gsang bdag chos kyi rgyal// bdud rtsi 'khyil pa pang du bai tā li// gri gug phur pa lcags drwa bhañja'i phyag /phyogs bzhi'i rtsibs steng rigs bzhi'i gshin rje gshed// nang ma'i rtsibs bcur phyogs skyong gshin rje bcu// phyi ma'i rtsibs bcur bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bcu// rtsibs mchan khro rgyal ma hā ba la bcu// sgo 'dzin ging bdud rtsis shan bzhi bzhi'i tshogs// gshin rje ma mo bdud btsan ma mgon zung*// gza' klu pe gtsang rgyal chen phyogs skyong tshogs// kun kyang rdo rje gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs// ye shes rnam lngas dbang bskur rgya yis btab// ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs gnyis med gyur// hūm̐/

kun bzang dgongs pa skye med las// skye ba'i cho 'phrul sku mchog lha// srid gsum log 'dren bsgral ba'i phyir// 'khor bcas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// oṃ mañju shrī ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a ti pū hoḥ pra ti dza hoḥ oṃ mañju shrī ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ sogs/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha hoḥ ma hā māṃ sa/ rak+ta/ kiṃ ni ri ti/ ba su ta/ ba liṃ ta khā hi/ oṃ mañju shrī ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza sa pa ri bā ra ma hā su kha gu h+ya pū dza hoḥ oṃ mañju shrī ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza sa pa ri bā ra pañca a mṛta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā ba liṃ ta pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hūm̐/ phyogs dus rgyal ba'i sku dngos 'jam pa'i dbyangs// shin tu 'jigs mdzad drag po'i skur bstan pa// nag phyogs rtsa lag rtsad nas 'byin mdzad pa'i// bcom ldan gshin rje gshed po 'khor bcas bstod// sngon tshe rgyal dang de sras thams cad kyis// gang dag zhi ba'i thabs kyis ma thul ba'i// ma rungs zhing bcu ldan pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ khyod kyis drag po'i las kyis tshar gcod mdzod// de nas bzlas pa'i rim pa ni/ rang nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po yi// thugs kar gsang bdag thugs dbus nyi ma'i steng*// ya yig gdan thabs steng du hūm̐ mthing nag /ha khog nang du muṃ yig dmar ser mtshan// de mthar rtsa sngags g.yas su 'khor ba las// 'od zer dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar 'phros// rgyal dang de sras khro rgyal ma lus mchod// mthu stobs byin rlabs kun bsdus rang la thim// 'gro ba'i nyon mongs bdud bgegs thams cad btul// bsod nams mthu nus kun bsdus bdag la thim// bdag nyid mthu stobs gzi brjid mtshungs med gyur// oṃ mañju shrī ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭaḥ snying po/ oṃ mañju shrī ya mān+ta ka kā la ru pa hrīṣ+ṭi wī kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ

nye snying*/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ ya me do ru/ ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni/ ra ya k+ṣe ya/ ya k+ṣe yats+tsha/ ni ra ma ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ rtsa sngags/ ces dang*/ oṃ mañju shrī ya mān+ta ka h+ya grī wa badz+ra pā ṇi ya ma rā dza a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa lī hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces dang*/ srung ba ni/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ nang bsrung bya 'khor bcas sbas// g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab bsrung bya thams cad gsal// phyi rol srung 'khor rdo rje'i rwa gur gsal// rdo rje'i go khrab zhu lub gsol ba las// rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa 'od zer dpag yas 'phros// pha rol srung ba'i rwa gur thams cad kun// bsdus nas rang gi srung 'khor la thim pas// sra mkhregs mi 'gyur rab tu brtan gyur pa// sred med bu yi stobs kyis mi bzlog cing*// rtsibs mchan ma hā ba la bcu po dang*// rtsibs nang bdud rtsi thabs sbyor bcu rnams kyis// nang du zhal gzigs skyabs sbyin phyag rgyas srung*// lha tshogs kun gyis srung sngags sgrog par gyur// rtsa sngags mthar/ ma ma rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/ zhes sbyar ba bzla/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ ya sngags phreng 'od zer gyis// dgra bo'i bla tshe srog gi dwangs ma dang*// stobs dang bsod nams kha rje dbang thang rnams// rang gi thugs kar thim pas bkrag mdangs dang*// mthu stobs gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par gyur// 'od des dgra bo bkugs te 'og gzhi yi// lcags khang ling gar bstims nas lce snying gzir// dgra bgegs sgo gsum nus mthu bcom par gyur// oṃ ya ma king kang kha truṃ nri myogs dgra bo wā ka s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ big nan dgra thuṃ te/ ti shan ti shan spur thuṃ spur brubs/ bi sha tsakra ha la ha la sa ma ya/ dgra sri s+t+wam+bha ya rak+sha nan/ drun drun laṃ laṃ s+t+wam+bha ya nan/ oṃ kha thun kha thun/ ya ma ya ma/ dun tri dun tri/ pra le dz+wa la pra le dz+wa la/ dgra bgegs kyi lus ngag yid gsum gdug rtsub gnod pa thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan chings shig kha thaṃ/

zhes bzla 'o/ /zlog pa ni/ rtsibs mchan ma hā ba la bcu po yis// phyir gzigs ba dan rlung g.yab g.yabs pa las// bskal pa'i rlung nag 'tshubs ma dpag med 'phros// byur dang mi kha dgra gyod jag rkun rnams// dbang med bya spu rlung gis gtor ba ltar// stong gsum nam mkha'i pha mthar bskrad par gyur// rtsa sngags sham du/ oṃ mi kha hur thums rbad rbad dril dril thuṃ thuṃ shig shig bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog sgyur sgyur/ yang king kang sngags ring yang bzla ste/ bdag nyid lhar gsal sku yi 'od zer las// me yi khro bo me yi mtshon cha dang*// dmag dpung rnam pa dpag tu med 'phros nas// byur dang mi kha dgra gyod jag rkun rnams/ kho rang rang gshed rang la phab nas kyang*// gzhob du bsregs nas gtan nas brlag par gyur// oṃ king kang kha trun nri myogs dgra bo wā ka s+t+wam+bha ya nan/ big nan dgra thuṃ te/ ti shan ti shan spur thuṃ spur brubs/ bhi sha tsakra ha la ha la sa ma ya/ dgra sri s+t+wam+bha ya rak+sha nan/ drun drun laṃ laṃ s+t+wam+bha ya nan/ oṃ kha thun kha thun/ ya ma ya ma/ dun tri dun tri/ pra le dz+wa la pra le dz+wa la zlog /byur mi kha dgra gyod jag rkun thams cad mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog /e ka du na zlog /ma hā du na zlog /sa ga du na zlog /rā tsa du na zlog /nā ga du na zlog /tsa dur snying na zlog /suṃ tri rak+sha zlog /byad zor phur kha chag che nyam nga dgra gyod mi kha bra mchu thams cad mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog bh+yo zlogs shig / de nas smad las ni/ e/ gnod byed dgra bgegs ma lus brub pa'i khung*// dug gsum las grub gshin rje'i grong khyer ni// lcags ri 'obs chen bdun gyis bskor ba'i dkyil// thar med btson khang gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang*// nri tri las byung gnod byed dgra dang bgegs// mngon gsum lta bur gsal ba nyid du gyur// gsad pa'i skabs zur 'debs ni/

thugs las dzaḥbazhi 'phros pas tshigs chen bzhir// dri za gshin rje srin po gnod sbyin gyi// mā ru tse bzhi tho ba lcags kyu 'dzin// sku smad rdo rje rtse gcig tshigs bzhir zug /ya yig bzhi las dgra bo'i phyogs bzhi ru// shar du chos rgyal dgra bo khram la 'debs// g.yas su yak+ṣa phag mgos sog le yis// dgra bo'i tshe srog skye rgyud rtsad nas gcod// 'char kas nub nas ri rab nag pos gnon// rngams pa dred mgos shal sdong la bskyon bya// zhes dang*/ bdag dang mdun bskyed rnams las sprul pa dang*// yang sprul pho nya dpag tu med pa spros// dam nyams dgra bo'i rnam par shes pa ni// mgon skyabs med pa rang dbang dang bral te// 'gugs byed lcags kyus snying ga'i nri nas bzung*// las kyi rlung dmar zhags pas ske nas bcings// 'jigs pa'i mun pa nag pos mdun nas bsus// las byed pho nyas hab sgra dir ri rir// rang dbang med par btson bzhin khrid nas kyang*// pho rnams g.yas dang mo rnams g.yon du bskor// bdag mdun brub khung mthar slebs 'khor rnams kyis// klad la g.yug cing lcags bsregs sa gzhir brdabs/ kho yi khong pa'i nang gi tshe dang bcud// thams cad yar skyugs bdag la tshur thim pas// dngos grub gsos gyur bkrag dang gzi mdangs rgyas// bcud bral sgye stong ltar gyur dgra bo ni// 'go ba'i lha lnga skyob byed dang bral te// lus rid nag po kem kem gyur pa dang*// rnam shes mar me 'chi kha'i 'od tsam dang*// bcas te brub khung nang gi ling gar thim/ /na mo/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung mar bcas// sngags 'chang bdag gi sngags dang ting nge 'dzin// dkon mchog gsum sogs bka' yi bden pa dang*// phrin las 'jam dpal shor sang nyi ma khros// gshin rje gshed po king kang dmar nag dang*// las kyi mtha' sdud 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rje// ma lus 'khor dang bcas te bden pa'i mthus// bla ma'i sku dgra bstan dang bstan 'dzin smod/

khyad par bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la// snga dgra lag bdar phyi dgra yid la sems// da dgra gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ kha 'jam snying rtsub zhe nas smod pa dang*// do bsdo phod btsugs bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byed// mthu dang nus pa bu lon bzhin du snyegs// dmag sna jag sna rkun sna ston pa dang*// gnod par byed pa'i dgra bo gang yin gyi// rnam shes bla tshe srog dang bcas pa rnams// gnam sa gling bzhi gling phran ri rab gseng*// nyi zla'i go bar chos bon srung ma'i skyabs// gang na 'dug kyang ling ga 'di nyid la/ khug cig badz+ra ang ku sha ya dzaḥ ske nas chings shig badz+ra pā sha hūm̐// yan lag sdoms shig badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ// myos par gyis shig badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ phyes shig badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭaḥ dbyer med stims shig ā we sha ya āḥ rtsa sngags dang*/ dgra bgegs dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dgra bo'i bla sha re ma ti 'grim 'grim/ sha ma ru ti thum thum myogs myogs yed yed/ sha ma ru ti khug khug /ling myogs/ ling sha ling thuṃ dzaḥ tsa mun+t+ri dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ yang*/ dgra bo che ge ā kar+ṣā ya hūm̐ dza dzaḥ yid 'gug pa'o// che ge'i rū pa skan+dha ā kar+ṣā ya dza dzaḥ rtsa sngags dang*/ shel shel dgra bo'i bla la shel/ shag shag dgra bo'i bla la shag /phung phung dgra bo'i bla la phung*// che ge'i bla khug aṃ ku sha dza dzaḥ dzaḥ ling gar bla srog khug pas dgra bo dngos// phyin chad 'chor ba med pa de lus la// skad cig nyid la g.yas su sbrul dkar po// lhan cig skyes pa dgra bo'i lha yin te// dam tshig nyams pas kho yi bdud du babs// spyi bor tshangs pa'i bu ga nas yar 'jib// snying ga yan chad khong khrag thams cad drangs// de bzhin g.yon du dug sbrul nag po gcig /byung ba mnyam por 'ong ba'i 'chi bdag bdud// yin te kho yi las dbang rang gshed gyur// gsang ba'i gnas nas mar la khong khrag rnams// drangs te mchin khri man chad 'jib cing drangs// sbrul dkar g.yas dang g.yon gyi nag po gnyis// 'dzing zhing 'thab cing dgra bo'i snying khrag la// za kha ma mthun lus kyi g.yas g.yon du// 'khril zhing mjug gnyis gsang ba'i gnas su mdud// mgo gnyis spyi bor mgul pa mdud byas nas// lus la 'khyud cing klad khung g.yas g.yon dang*// rna bar kha gdang lces ldag so yis 'debs// de tshe spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje ni/

ra gdeng lus las rlung gis shugs drag 'khor// gsor ltar bsnun pas klad khrag snying khrag rnams// zho ltar dkrugs pa sbrul chen gnyis kyis 'jib// dkar nag sbrul gnyis je cher stobs ldan gyur// oṃ king kang kha trun nri myogs dgra bo wā ka s+t+wam+bha ya nan/ big nan dgra thuṃ te/ ti shan ti shan spur thuṃ spur brubs/ bhi sha tsakra ha la ha la sa ma ya/ dgra sri s+t+wam+bha ya rak+sha nan/ drun drun laṃ laṃ s+t+wam+bha ya nan/ oṃ kha thun kha thun/ ya ma ya ma/ dun tri dun tri/ pra le dz+wa la pra le dz+wa la/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan chings shig / yang na/ oṃ king kang thuṃ ril nri myogs sgribs dgra bo wā ka s+t+wam+bha ya nan: big nan dgra thuṃ de sho de shaṃ byur brubs: bi sha tsakra ha la ha la: hal ta hal ta: hūm̐ sa ma ya sgribs hring: dgra bo s+t+wam+bha ya rak+sha nan: hūm̐ hūm̐ laṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ thuṃ laṃ: dgra bo mā ra ya rbad nan chings shig: mthar/ sbrul gnyis dug gi sog ler gyur// tshangs bug nas zhugs nang khrol rnams// bshang sgor drangs te 'dre srin gyi// tshangs pas hab thob zos par gyur// glang ru'i tshe/ rang nyid king kang phur sham can// dgra bo'i snying gar zug pa dang*// phyag g.yas lcags kyus bsgrub bya bkug /g.yon pas tho lum rkang lag dang*// mgo bo rnams ni brdung zhing bcom// klad pa'i nang du mun nag gi /g.yung drung g.yon 'khor lus sems myos// sngags ring sham du/ za dgos rdung dgos 'phrog dgos rku dgos zer ba'i dgra bo thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan chings shig kha thaṃ/ de dag gi skabs su dmod bcol yang bya'o/ /gsad pa ni/ dzaḥ lhan skyes ngo bo sbrul med dgra bo yi// lus kyi steng du drag po'i thun gyi rdzas// brgyabs pa thams cad mtshon cha'i char du gyur// tshal pa tshal pa dum bu dum bur gtubs// zhes dang*/ spyi bor ya ma rā dza ral gcig ma// mgrin par myos byed 'bar ba tsaṇ+ḍa lī// snying gar ār+ya ma ru 'od zer can// lte bar ral pa tshar dgu re ba ti// yab rnams yar gzigs yum rnams thur la gzigs// rim bzhin gser dngul zangs lcags 'khor lo rnams// yab rnams yar bskor yum rnams thur du bskor// rtsa 'dab klad pa don snying sha rus gtubs//

yab sngags kyi gsham du/ oṃ ru ru rak+mo ti tsa snying la rbad/ thum ril kha khug yak+sha rbad/ thuṃ ril bh+yo/ sha si ra dha kha tri mi kha thuṃ ril/ ga du naṃ kuṃ yak+sha naṃ dgra bgegs kha thaṃ/ nā sha ya nā sha ya gnod byed ngag s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ mā ra ya rbad/ ru ru rak+mo hur thums dzaḥ dgra bo'i srog la mā ra rbad/

ces dang dkyus ni sngags ring gsham du/ dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan sod/ tad+ya thā: du shan du shan: rak+sha rak+sha: dgra bo'i srog rtsa snying rtsa khrag rtsa la 'dus 'dus: dgra bo'i snying rtsa srog rtsa khrag rtsa la rbad rbad: dgra bo'i srog rtsa snying rtsa khrag rtsa la chod chod: mā ra ya rbad sod: ces so// lo zla zhag dus la dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan/ srog lus dbang thang rlung rta la dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan/ mi kha dang dgra sna me ltar du 'bar zhing chu ltar 'brub pa thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan/ mi kha dang dgra sna rlung ltar 'tshubs shing sa ltar g.yo ba thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan/ dmag sna jag sna rkun sna ston pa thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan/ ngo la gdong thug byed cing lkog nas 'bu bzhin 'bug pa thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan/ gsod shom rku shom 'phrog shom byed pa thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan/ brgya yi mi kha stong gi bra mchu thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan/ nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi dgra 'dre byur gsum thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan/ lus la na tsha dang sems la sdug bsngal gtong ba thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan/ zas nor la god kha dang bsam pa la bar chad gtong ba thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan/ snga dgra lag la bdar pa phyi dgra yid la sems pa da dgra thad du langs pa thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan/ oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ sarba sha trūn mā ra ya rbad nan chings shig / khug rtags byung nas/ mdun bskyed 'khor bcas phur zhabs gyur// bsgrub bya'i snying gar gshin rje gshed// de mdun yum dang phyogs bzhi ru// sras bzhi ma srin bdud btsan bzhi// mdor na mthil bzhi tshul gyi lus// 'khor dang bcas pas sa gzhi la// thug par btab pa nyid du gyur// hūm̐/ gnyis med chos dbyings rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// 'gro don ma lus rang byung lhun grub lha// bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/

khyad par lhag pa'i lha mchog gshin rje gshed// mi bzad rab 'jigs khro gtum 'bar ba'i sku// 'khor dang bcas pa 'gro ba'i don la skul/ khyed kyi thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la babs// yid la brnags pa'i dam nyams dgra dang bgegs// dug khrag thun mtshon nad kyi char phab nas// gzugs phung bla srog rnam shes rdul du rlogs// myur sgrol mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las mdzod// ces pas bskul lo// phur pa rdeg cing*/ hūm̐/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus dpal// sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya// sku stod rab 'jigs khro bo'i sku// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing khros// kī la ya yi sgra chen sgrog /phyag drug mtshon cha'i char pa 'beb// sku rked chu srin rngams pa'i zhal// sbrul nag zhags pa glog ltar 'khyugs// sku smad phur bu zur gsum la// lcags sreg tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs// gang la btab kyang rdul du brlag /khyod kyi thugs dam dus la babs// yid la brnags pa'i dgra bgegs kyi// gzugs phung thal ba rdul du rlogs// dug gsum ma rig gzhi rtsa chod// sdang byed dam nyams dgra dang bgegs// ming tsam med par rdul du rlogs// oṃ mañju shrī ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza badz+ra kī li kī la ya dgra bgegs nri tri sha trūn mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ral gris gtub cing*/ hūm̐/ shes rab ral gri me ltar 'bar// gri thun drag po chu ltar 'brub// gang la dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs kyi// gti mug sha yi phung po gtubs// de nas zhal bstab ni/ hūm̐/ gru gsum bhañja 'bar ba yangs pa'i snod// phyi nang dbang po lnga dang don snying lnga// klad rus rkang mar khong khrag bla tshe dbugs// bcom ldan gshin rje gshed po'i zhal du bstab// yum mchog bai tā li yi zhal du bstab// go cha'i khro rgyal lnga yi zhal du bstab// sras mchog rigs bzhi yab yum zhal du bstab// phyogs skyong gshin rje yab yum zhal du bstab// ging bdud rtsis shan bcu drug zhal du bstab// gshin rje ma mo bdud btsan zhal du bstab// ma mgon gza' klu pe gtsang zhal du bstab// rgyal chen phyogs skyong rnams kyi zhal du bstab// snang srid lha srin sde brgyad zhal du bstab// gti mug sha la chem chem dgyes par rol// 'dod chags khrag la ljib ljib dgyes par rol// zhe sdang rus la krum krum dgyes par rol// zhal du bstab bo bzhes shig khā raṃ khā hi/

mgul du bstim mo badz+ra a ral+li ho/ lhag med dbyings su rol cig sa ma ya/ de nas zlog pa'i phrin las bcol ba ni/ rgyas par rtags zlog dang bsdu ba'i tshe na/ bh+yoḥ sngon tshe zlog pa gang nas byung*// bcom ldan rgyal ba shāka thub la// lhas byin bdud kyi chad pa byung*/ khrag kong byol zor 'di yis bzlogs// de 'og za hor rgyal po la// ban bon sngags zor 'dus pa rnams/ khrag kong byol zor 'di yis bzlogs// sngon dus de ltar bzlogs pa ltar// bh+yoḥ mdos zor sha khrag gtor ma 'dis// da lta rnal 'byor dpon slob la// sde brgyad chad pa byung ba zlogs// byad zor phur kha thams cad zlog /ban dhe'i sngags zor 'dus pa= mu stegs bon po'i dzo dmar= lha 'dre'i za kha zug pa= rgyal po lo yi bdun zur= blon po zla ba'i dbang btsan= dmag mi zhag gi dpung dgra= mtshon cha dus kyi rno ngar= spar kha'i skya mda' zug pa= sme ba dur du chud pa= sa bdag ko long bsdams pa= 'byung ba'i dgra gshed 'thabs pa= gza' skar dus tshes ngan pa= lo zla zhag dus skag babs zlog /khram dang byad du bcug pa= hom dang par bu bskor pa= dgra chen bdud du langs pa= ltas ngan glo bur ye 'drog= dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad= mi kha bra mchu thams cad= chag che nyam nga thams cad= sngon bsgug phyi nas 'ded pa= dgra sna phung sna gyod sna= nad sna yams sna rims sna= dgra sri mo rmi ngan pa= che sri chung sri rgan sri= gzhon sri dar sri god sri= dgra sri mtshon sri nad sri= mdor na srid pa'i chag sgo dang*// bdag la gnod pa'i dgra 'dre rnams// sdang byed dgra yi steng du bh+yo// gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du bh+yoḥ /bar chad bdud kyi steng du bh+yoḥ /za 'dre phung sri'i steng du zor// dam nyams byad ma'i steng du bh+yoḥ king kang gi sngags ring dang*/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya nan zlog /e ka du na zlog

/ma hā du na zlog /sa ga du na zlog /rā tsa du na zlog /nā ga du na zlog /tsa dur snying na zlog /suṃ tri rak+sha zlog /byad zor phur kha chag che nyam nga thams cad mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ zlog zlog /e sa bh+yo zlog / de nas zor gyi pho nya bskul ba ni/ bh+yo/ nyi ma lho phyogs pha gi na// rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og na// las kyi gshin rje'i dmag tshogs rnams/ khri dang drug stong 'khor dang bcas// rgyal chen phyogs skyong pho nyar 'gyed// lha 'dre stong sde las la 'dzud// kun kyang 'ur sgra chems se chem// phyag na zlog pa'i kong zor thogs// rang rtags mtshon cha me ltar 'bar// sngon nas byad zor bzlogs pa'i lha// dmar chen gtor ma 'di bzhes la// do nub zlog pa'i dpung la chos// dgra dpung g.yul ngo zlog par mdzod// ya ma rā dza dgra bgegs kyi snying la bh+yo bh+yoḥ thun mtshams su changs ril bshams nas gzi brjid tshad med sngags kyis yongs su spel te/ dam nyams khyod la lan chags 'jal ba ni/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du bsad pa tshe thung ba'i lan chags 'jal lo// brdungs pa nad mang ba'i lan chags 'jal lo// brkus phrogs longs spyod nor dbul ba'i lan chags 'jal lo// mi rta gri ru bsad pa'i lan chags 'jal lo// mtho ba mkhar sogs nas phab pa'i lan chags 'jal lo// dma' ba yul zhing bcom pa'i lan chags 'jal lo// gser dngul bye ru'i lan chags 'jal lo// bang khang 'bru yi lan chags 'jal lo// lhab lhub gos kyi lan chags 'jal lo// de la sogs pa'i lan chags byang*/ bu lon thams cad sod pa yin no// zhes brjod do// changs ril 'dod yon lnga'i phung po// bsngos pas sngar nas da phan gyi// zas nor srog gi lan chags byang*// bu lon sha mkhon bral bar bsam/ /phyag 'tshal ba ni/ rang nyid shāka thub sku mdog nag /dar nag chos gos rnam gsum bklubs// rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyis bskor// dbu skra ral gri spu gri yis// dgye dang rgu dus yar mar gshag

/phyag sna ma thub dgra de yi// stobs nus tshe bsod thams cad zad// sa 'og rim dgur lhung bar bsam// gsad gnon gyi sngags bzla bzhin par phyag byed do/ /de nas zor gyi sa mā dhi ni/ mdun bskyed dpal chen mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon nas// bdud btsan ma gshin sde brgyad dmag dpung spros// dpal gyi sku gsung thugs sprul khro bo dang*/ khro mo'i tshogs kyis dgra yi yul du bdas// dgra mkhar bshig bsad sha khrag hab thob zos// dgra bo'i stobs nus zhe sdang sbyor ngan rnams// bskal mes bsregs rjes chus bshal rlung gis gtor// ming yang med par dmigs med stong nyid gyur// ces so/ /gnan pa'i sa mā dhi ni/ e/ phyag g.yas ral gris bsnun pas sa gzhi gas// chu me rlung gi dkyil 'khora'ang bkas 'og nas// las kyi gshin rje ma he khros pa'i gdong*// gnam sa tsam gyi kha gdangs 'o dod 'bod// de tshe snang srid lha 'dre thams cad kyis// dgra jag gyod rkun mi kha gdon bgegs rnams// dbang med ded nas las gshin zhal du bstabs// bh+yoḥ nyi ma lho phyogs pha gi na// zhes sogs gnan bskul gang rigs btang nas/ liṅga dgra bo nyid dang dbyer med pa// las gshin zhal du 'phangs pas 'dzum mdangs shor/ kha bsdams 'og phyogs gshin rje'i yul du song*// de steng rlung me chu sa'i dkyil 'khor chags// ri rab rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu// 'jam dpal sras bcas kun gyis mnan par gyur/ /lo zla zhag dus la dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan/ zhes sogs dmod pa brjod/ rang nyid lhar gsal zhabs su dgra bo tshud// lcags khang sgo med nang du dgra bgegs rnams// gnam lcags 'dzer btab rdo rje rgya gram dang*// de steng ri rab kyis mnan thar med gyur// king kang gi sngags ring dang*/ gnod byed dgra bgegs mi kha bra mchu thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan/ dgra bo sa yi khams suṃ nan/

me yi khams raṃ nan/ chu'i khams baṃ nan/ rlung gi khams yaṃ nan/ nam mkha'i khams e nan/ rnam par shes pa'i khams s+t+waṃ bha ya nan// zhes brjod do// dgra bgegs ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha/ ts+tshin+dha ya ts+tshin+dha ya/ bhin+dha bhin+dha/ bhin+dha ya bhin+dha ya/ tā ḍa tā ḍa/ tā ḍa ya tā ḍa ya/ mā ra mā ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ s+t+waṃ bha s+t+waṃ bha/ s+t+waṃ bha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ ha sa nā ya/ bh+ya brta na ya/ ma tsi ra na/ mā ra ya nan/ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad brjod/ steng du khro bcu zhabs bsgrad phyir gzigs mnan// de steng hūm̐ mthing las byung rgya gram ljang*// me lce'i phreng bskor khro bcu'i spyi bsdus mnan// lte bar suṃ ser las byung sa dkyil ser// oṃ badz+ra su me ru hūm̐ hūm̐ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ de steng gser gyi lhun pos mnan pa'i steng*// don grub ljang gu dbu gsum phyag drug pa// g.yas gsum 'khor lo tri shul thod khrag dang*// rgya gram dgra sta phur bu g.yon na 'dzin// 'khor dang bcas pas ldang med mnan par bsam// oṃ badz+ra kro dha kha kha ha ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐/ hūm̐ mdzad phyag rgya khar 'phyar te/ rdo rje gnod sbyin sngags rgyas btab// don grub 'khor bcas pho brang btab/ khyod ni byang chub ma skyes par// nam yang ldang ba med par shog / ces brjod do/ /de nas bgegs tshogs gzir na/ phyi rol gnam sa gnyis po gnam lcags kyi// 'khor lo rtsibs stong spu gri ltar rno ba// g.yas g.yon drag tu 'khor ba'i rtsibs bar du// gnod byed gang dag myal myal hrug hrug gtubs// rtsibs nang gshin rje rnams kyis gsol bar gyur// oṃ ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ e trig nan nri tri hur thums dzaḥ byad ma mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ rlung gi rnal 'byor ni/ lte ba'i nyi bu'i gsus khyim nang*// srid pa las kyi 'khor lo 'bar// ro rkyang lam nas rlung sbyor gyi// pho nya'i dpung gis bkug nas de// nyi bu'i zhal bstabs 'khor lor bskyon//

zhes so// mdun bskyed gnas lnga'i 'od zer kha dog lnga// rang gi gnas lngar thim pas dbang bzhi thob// rtsa sngags kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wā ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ sarba sid+dhi hrīḥ srung 'khor lhar bcas thugs srog hūm̐ la thim// de yang mi dmigs ka dag gdod ma'i klong*/ /'jam dpal ji ltar mkhyen cing dpa' ba dang*// kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing*// dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo// dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis// bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des// bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang*// bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi// zhes dang*/ gang tshe blta bar 'dod pa 'am// cung zad dri bar 'dod na yang*// 'jam dpal khro bo de nyid ni// gegs med par yang mthong bar shog /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i// sems can kun don bsgrub bya'i phyir// 'jam dpal khro bos spyod mdzad pa// bdag gi spyod pa'ang de 'drar shog / gzhan yang shis pa brjod pa sogs gsang ba spyi ltar bya'o// gshin rje gshed kyi drag sngags kyi// gal mdo 'di shes mngon spyod kyi// gsang ba spyi 'doms cho ga ste// tshe dbang kun khyab blo mtsho las so// dza yan+tu/// /
